turnaround_reason: Acetyl-chain/engineered-materials producer over-levered from the DuPont M&M deal and hit by a weak chemicals cycle; the thesis is a deleveraging + acetyl-rebound recovery.
bullish_points: Clear deleveraging path: net debt $11.3B → ~$10B by YE26, <$9B by YE27
H2 2026 EPS guided ~$3.00; raised FCF outlook to $700-800M
Forward P/E ~7.3 with real earnings torque as the cycle turns
Cost savings ($120M in 2025, +$50-70M in 2026) support the recovery
bearish_points: Very high leverage (~6x, D/E ~270%) — the discount IS the leverage risk
Acetyl chain still oversupplied; Q1 operating profit -41%
TTM net loss; recovery depends on an uncertain demand/pricing rebound
Cyclical and rate-sensitive — a weaker macro delays deleveraging
catalyst: Sequential acetyl-chain volume/price rebound + visible net-debt reduction each quarter
suggested_trade: Spot starter near $45 as a leveraged deleveraging play; size for volatility; see data/research/CE.md
key_risk: Chemicals demand stays weak, deleveraging stalls, and the leverage becomes the story
would_skip_if: Acetyl pricing rolls over or net-debt targets slip
